{{Quote|You've got mop-up duty, Bren.|A Rebel commander to Bren Harvist|<ref name="Terror in the Trees">{{WEGCite|story=Terror in the Trees|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>}}
'''Bren Harvist''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who was stationed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He was in command of the Rebel commando group [[Recon-A]] who had been assigned to an [[Unidentified Ewok village (Sector 5-7)|Ewok village]] to help its inhabitants recover from the Battle of Endor. As the village was [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|assaulted]] by a group of abandoned [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], Harvist and his men and their [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] allies defended the village.
